sentences.ja: 「大きくなってね。毎日、水をあげるからね。」
sentences.romaji: “Ookiku natte ne. Mainichi, mizu o ageru kara ne.”

translations.vi: "Lớn nhanh nhé. Ngày nào chị cũng tưới nước cho em."
translations.en: "Grow big, okay? I'll water you every day."
translations.zh-Hans: “快长大哦。我每天都给你浇水。”
translations.zh-Hant: “快長大哦。我每天都給你澆水。”
translations.tl: "Lumaki ka, ha. Didiligan kita araw-araw."
translations.ne: "ठूलो हुनू है। म हरेक दिन पानी हाल्छु।"
translations.id: "Cepat besar, ya. Tiap hari aku siram."
translations.pt: "Cresça, tá? Vou te regar todo dia."
translations.th: "โตไว ๆ นะ จะรดน้ำให้ทุกวันเลย"
translations.si: "ලොකු වෙන්න හොඳේ. මම හැමදාම වතුර දානවා."

grammarNote.vi: 水をあげる = tưới nước (cho cây).
grammarNote.my: 水をあげる = ရေလောင်းတယ်။
grammarNote.th: 水をあげる = รดน้ำ

furigana.surface: ビンくんは、トマトがきらいです。

translations.pt: Bin odeia tomate.
translations.my: ဘင်က ခရမ်းချဉ်သီး မကြိုက်ဘူး။

sentences.ja: 「ぼく、トマトは食べないよ。赤くて、ぐにゃぐにゃだもん。」

furigana.surface: くて、ぐにゃぐにゃだもん。」

sentences.romaji: “Boku, tomato wa tabenai yo. Akakute, gunyagunya da mon.”

translations.vi: "Em không ăn cà chua đâu. Nó đỏ mà còn nhũn nhũn."
translations.en: "I won't eat tomatoes. They're red and squishy."
translations.zh-Hans: “我才不吃番茄。红红的，软趴趴的。”
translations.zh-Hant: “我才不吃番茄。紅紅的，軟趴趴的。”
translations.tl: "Hindi ako kakain ng kamatis. Pula at malambot."
translations.id: "Aku nggak makan tomat. Merah dan lembek."
translations.pt: "Eu não como tomate. É vermelho e molenga."
translations.th: "ผมไม่กินมะเขือเทศหรอก แดงแล้วก็นิ่มเละ"
translations.si: "මම තක්කාලි කන්නේ නැහැ. රතුයි, ලිහිල් ලිහිල්."

grammarNote.vi: ぐにゃぐにゃ = nhũn, mềm oặt.
grammarNote.en: ぐにゃぐにゃ = squishy, floppy.
grammarNote.my: ぐにゃぐにゃ = ပျော့ဖတ်ဖတ်။
grammarNote.th: ぐにゃぐにゃ = นิ่มเละ
grammarNote.si: ぐにゃぐにゃ = ලිහිල්, මෘදු.

translations.vi: Một tuần sau, những mầm nhỏ nhú lên.

translations.tl: Pagkalipas ng isang linggo, may maliliit na usbong.
translations.pt: Uma semana depois, brotaram pequenas mudas.
translations.my: တစ်ပတ်ကြာတော့ အညွန့်လေးတွေ ထွက်လာတယ်။

translations.si: සතියකට පස්සේ, පොඩි පැළ මතු වුණා.

grammarNote.vi: め = mầm. 一週間あと = một tuần sau.
grammarNote.en: め = sprout. 一週間あと = a week later.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: め＝芽。一週間あと＝一周后。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: め＝芽。一週間あと＝一週後。
grammarNote.my: め = အညွန့်။
grammarNote.th: め = หน่อ
grammarNote.si: め = පැළය, දළුව. 一週間あと = සතියකට පස්සේ.

sentences.romaji: “Bin, mite! Midori no akachan da yo!”

translations.vi: "Bin ơi, nhìn này! Em bé màu xanh đấy!"
translations.en: "Bin, look! Green babies!"
translations.tl: "Bin, tingnan mo! Berdeng sanggol!"
translations.pt: "Bin, olha! Bebês verdinhos!"
translations.th: "บิน ดูสิ! เบบี๋สีเขียว!"

grammarNote.vi: 赤ちゃん = em bé.

sentences.romaji: “...... Chotto, kawaii ne.”

translations.vi: "...Cũng hơi dễ thương."
translations.en: "...They're kind of cute."
translations.tl: "...Medyo cute, ah."
translations.pt: "...São meio fofinhos."
translations.my: "...နည်းနည်း ချစ်စရာကောင်းတယ်။"

translations.vi: Từ đó, sáng nào Bin cũng ra ban công.
translations.en: After that, Bin came to the balcony every morning too.
translations.zh-Hans: 从那以后，小宾每天早上也来阳台。
translations.zh-Hant: 從那以後，小賓每天早上也來陽臺。
translations.ko: 그 후로 빈도 매일 아침 베란다에 왔습니다.
translations.tl: Mula noon, pumupunta rin si Bin sa balkonahe tuwing umaga.
translations.ne: त्यसपछि बिन पनि हरेक बिहान बार्दलीमा आयो।
translations.id: Sejak itu, Bin juga datang ke balkon tiap pagi.
translations.pt: Desde então, Bin também ia à varanda toda manhã.
translations.my: အဲဒီနောက် ဘင်လည်း မနက်တိုင်း ဝရန်တာ လာတယ်။
translations.th: ตั้งแต่นั้น บินก็มาที่ระเบียงทุกเช้า
translations.si: ඊට පස්සේ, බින්-කුනුත් හැමදාම උදේ බැල්කනියට ආවා.

translations.tl: Sabay silang nagdidilig.
translations.pt: Os dois regam juntos.

sentences.romaji: Binkun wa, tomato ni hanashikakemasu.

translations.vi: Bin nói chuyện với cây cà chua.
translations.en: Bin talks to the tomato plants.
translations.tl: Kinakausap ni Bin ang kamatis.
translations.pt: Bin conversa com os tomates.

sentences.romaji: “Ohayou, tomatokun. Kyou mo atsui ne.”

translations.vi: "Chào buổi sáng, bạn Cà Chua. Hôm nay lại nóng nhỉ."
translations.en: "Morning, Mr. Tomato. Hot again today, huh?"
translations.zh-Hans: “早上好，番茄君。今天也很热呢。”
translations.zh-Hant: “早上好，番茄君。今天也很熱呢。”
translations.tl: "Magandang umaga, G. Kamatis. Mainit na naman."
translations.ne: "शुभ प्रभात, गोलभेडा भाइ। आज पनि गर्मी छ है।"
translations.id: "Pagi, Tomat. Hari ini panas lagi, ya."
translations.pt: "Bom dia, seu Tomate. Calor de novo, hein?"
translations.my: "မင်္ဂလာနံနက်ပါ ခရမ်းချဉ်လေး။ ဒီနေ့လည်း ပူတယ်နော်။"
translations.th: "อรุณสวัสดิ์ คุณมะเขือเทศ วันนี้ก็ร้อนนะ"

grammarNote.vi: 〜くん = gọi thân mật (thường với con trai).

grammarNote.si: 〜くん = හිතවත් නාම අවසානය (බොහෝවිට පිරිමි ළමයි).

sentences.ja: めは、どんどん大きくなりました。
sentences.romaji: Me wa, dondon ookiku narimashita.

translations.vi: Mầm cây lớn nhanh vùn vụt.
translations.en: The sprouts grew bigger and bigger.
translations.tl: Mabilis na lumaki ang mga usbong.
translations.pt: As mudas cresceram rapidinho.
translations.my: အညွန့်တွေ မြန်မြန် ကြီးလာတယ်။
translations.th: หน่อโตขึ้นเรื่อย ๆ

meanings.my: တဖြည်းဖြည်းမြန်မြန်
meanings.th: เรื่อย ๆ อย่างรวดเร็ว

grammarNote.zh-Hans: どんどん＝迅速地，不断地。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: どんどん＝迅速地，不斷地。
grammarNote.my: どんどん = မြန်မြန်။
grammarNote.th: どんどん = เรื่อย ๆ
grammarNote.si: どんどん = තව තවත්, වේගයෙන්.

sentences.ja: 六月に、黄色い小さな花がさきました。
sentences.romaji: Rokugatsu ni, kiiroi chiisana hana ga sakimashita.

translations.vi: Tháng Sáu, những bông hoa nhỏ màu vàng nở.
translations.en: In June, little yellow flowers bloomed.
translations.zh-Hans: 六月开出了黄色的小花。
translations.zh-Hant: 六月開出了黃色的小花。
translations.tl: Noong Hunyo, namulaklak ang maliliit na dilaw na bulaklak.
translations.id: Bulan Juni, bunga kuning kecil mekar.
translations.pt: Em junho, nasceram florzinhas amarelas.
translations.my: ဇွန်လမှာ အဝါရောင် ပန်းလေးတွေ ပွင့်တယ်။
translations.th: เดือนมิถุนายน ดอกเล็ก ๆ สีเหลืองก็บาน
translations.si: ජූනි මාසේ, පොඩි කහ මල් පිපුණා.

grammarNote.vi: さく = (hoa) nở.
grammarNote.my: さく = ပွင့်တယ်။
grammarNote.th: さく = บาน

sentences.romaji: Shichigatsu ni wa, midori no mi ga takusan dekimashita.

translations.vi: Tháng Bảy, rất nhiều quả xanh kết trái.
translations.en: In July, lots of green fruit appeared.
translations.zh-Hans: 七月结了很多绿色的果子。
translations.zh-Hant: 七月結了很多綠色的果子。
translations.tl: Noong Hulyo, maraming berdeng bunga.
translations.id: Bulan Juli, banyak buah hijau tumbuh.
translations.pt: Em julho, apareceram muitos frutinhos verdes.
translations.my: ဇူလိုင်လမှာ အစိမ်းရောင် အသီးတွေ အများကြီး သီးတယ်။
translations.th: เดือนกรกฎาคม มีผลสีเขียวออกมาเต็มเลย
translations.si: ජූලි මාසේ, කොළ පාට ගෙඩි ගොඩක් හැදුණා.

grammarNote.vi: 実 = quả. できる = (quả) hình thành, ra.
grammarNote.en: 実 = fruit. できる = form, appear.
grammarNote.my: 実 = အသီး။
grammarNote.th: 実 = ผล
grammarNote.si: 実 = ගෙඩිය. できる = හැදෙනවා.

sentences.ja: 「早く赤くならないかな。」
sentences.romaji: “Hayaku akaku naranai ka na.”

translations.vi: "Không biết bao giờ mới đỏ nhỉ."
translations.en: "I wonder when they'll turn red."
translations.tl: "Kailan kaya sila mamumula?"
translations.pt: "Quando será que vão ficar vermelhos?"
translations.my: "မြန်မြန် နီလာရင် ကောင်းမှာ။"
translations.th: "เมื่อไหร่จะแดงนะ"

grammarNote.vi: 〜ないかな = mong là ~ (ước mong).
grammarNote.en: 〜ないかな = I wish ~ / I wonder if ~.
grammarNote.my: 〜ないかな = ~ ရင် ကောင်းမှာ။
grammarNote.th: 〜ないかな = อยากให้ ~ จัง
grammarNote.si: 〜ないかな = ~ වෙනවා නම් හොඳයි / ~ ද දන්නේ නැහැ.

sentences.ja: ある朝、一つの実が、まっ赤になっていました。
sentences.romaji: Aru asa, hitotsu no mi ga, makka ni natteimashita.

translations.vi: Một buổi sáng, có một quả đã đỏ chót.
translations.en: One morning, one fruit had turned bright red.
translations.zh-Hans: 一天早上，有一个果子变得红红的。
translations.zh-Hant: 一天早上，有一個果子變得紅紅的。
translations.ko: 어느 날 아침, 열매 하나가 새빨갛게 익었습니다.
translations.tl: Isang umaga, pulang-pula na ang isang bunga.
translations.ne: एक बिहान, एउटा फल टकटकाउँदो रातो भयो।
translations.id: Suatu pagi, satu buah sudah merah merona.
translations.pt: Certa manhã, um fruto estava vermelhinho.
translations.my: တစ်မနက်မှာ အသီးတစ်လုံး နီရဲနေပြီ။
translations.th: เช้าวันหนึ่ง มีผลหนึ่งแดงแจ๋
translations.si: දවසක් උදේ, එක ගෙඩියක් තද රතු පාට වෙලා තිබුණා.

grammarNote.vi: まっ赤 (まっか) = đỏ chót.
grammarNote.en: まっ赤 (まっか) = bright red.
grammarNote.my: まっ赤 = နီရဲ။
grammarNote.th: まっ赤 = แดงแจ๋
grammarNote.si: まっ赤 (まっか) = තද රතු.

sentences.ja: 「やった！ 一つめのトマト！」
sentences.romaji: “Yatta! Hitotsume no tomato!”

translations.vi: "Yeah! Quả cà chua đầu tiên!"
translations.en: "Yay! The first tomato!"
translations.tl: "Yehey! Ang unang kamatis!"
translations.pt: "Oba! O primeiro tomate!"
translations.my: "ဟေး! ပထမဆုံး ခရမ်းချဉ်သီး!"
translations.th: "เย้! มะเขือเทศลูกแรก!"

grammarNote.vi: 一つめ = cái thứ nhất.
grammarNote.my: 一つめ = ပထမ။
grammarNote.th: 一つめ = อันแรก

sentences.ja: 「ぼくが見つけたかった……。」
sentences.romaji: “Boku ga mitsuketakatta.......”

translations.vi: "Em muốn là người tìm ra nó..."
translations.en: "I wanted to find it first..."
translations.tl: "Gusto ko sanang ako ang nakakita..."
translations.pt: "Eu queria ter achado..."
translations.th: "ผมอยากเป็นคนเจอก่อน..."

grammarNote.vi: 〜たかった = đã muốn ~.
grammarNote.my: 〜たかった = ~ ချင်ခဲ့တယ်။
grammarNote.th: 〜たかった = อยาก ~ (อดีต)

sentences.ja: 「じゃあ、明日、二人で食べよう。」
sentences.romaji: “Jaa, ashita, futari de tabeyou.”

translations.vi: "Vậy mai hai chị em mình cùng ăn nhé."
translations.en: "Then let's eat it together tomorrow."
translations.tl: "Sige, kainin natin bukas nang sabay."
translations.pt: "Então amanhã a gente come junto."
translations.my: "ဒါဆို မနက်ဖြန် နှစ်ယောက်အတူ စားကြမယ်။"
translations.th: "งั้นพรุ่งนี้กินด้วยกันนะ"

grammarNote.vi: 食べよう = cùng ăn nào (thể ý chí).
grammarNote.my: 食べよう = စားကြစို့။
grammarNote.th: 食べよう = กินกันเถอะ

sentences.ja: でも、次の朝、赤いトマトがありませんでした。

furigana.surface: いトマトがありませんでした。

sentences.romaji: Demo, tsugi no asa, akai tomato ga arimasendeshita.

translations.vi: Nhưng sáng hôm sau, quả cà chua đỏ không còn nữa.
translations.en: But the next morning, the red tomato was gone.
translations.zh-Hans: 可是第二天早上，红番茄不见了。
translations.zh-Hant: 可是第二天早上，紅番茄不見了。
translations.ko: 그런데 다음 날 아침, 빨간 토마토가 없었습니다.
translations.tl: Pero kinaumagahan, wala na ang pulang kamatis.
translations.ne: तर भोलिपल्ट बिहान रातो गोलभेडा थिएन।
translations.id: Tapi keesokan paginya, tomat merah itu hilang.
translations.pt: Mas na manhã seguinte, o tomate vermelho tinha sumido.
translations.my: ဒါပေမဲ့ နောက်တစ်နေ့မနက် ခရမ်းချဉ်သီးနီ မရှိတော့ဘူး။
translations.th: แต่เช้าวันต่อมา มะเขือเทศสีแดงหายไป
translations.si: ඒත් පහුවදා උදේ, රතු තක්කාලිය තිබුණේ නැහැ.

grammarNote.vi: 〜ませんでした = đã không ~ (quá khứ phủ định).
grammarNote.en: 〜ませんでした = was not / did not (polite past negative).
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 〜ませんでした＝没有……（礼貌过去否定）。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 〜ませんでした＝沒有……（禮貌過去否定）。
grammarNote.my: 〜ませんでした = မ ~ ခဲ့ဘူး။
grammarNote.th: 〜ませんでした = ไม่ได้ ~ (อดีต)
grammarNote.si: 〜ませんでした = ~ නැහැ (ගෞරවනීය අතීත නිෂේධය).

sentences.ja: 「あれ？ ない！ ビン、食べたの？」
sentences.romaji: “Are? Nai! Bin, tabeta no?”

translations.vi: "Ơ? Mất rồi! Bin, em ăn rồi à?"
translations.en: "Huh? It's gone! Bin, did you eat it?"
translations.tl: "Ha? Wala na! Bin, kinain mo ba?"
translations.pt: "Ué? Sumiu! Bin, você comeu?"
translations.my: "ဟင်? မရှိဘူး! ဘင်၊ နင် စားလိုက်တာလား။"
translations.th: "อ้าว? หายไป! บิน กินไปเหรอ"

grammarNote.vi: あれ？ = ơ, ủa (ngạc nhiên).
grammarNote.my: あれ？ = ဟင်?
grammarNote.th: あれ？ = อ้าว?

sentences.ja: 「食べてないよ！ ぼく、トマトきらいだもん！」

furigana.surface: べてないよ！ ぼく、トマトきらいだもん！」

sentences.romaji: “Tabetenai yo! Boku, tomato kirai da mon!”

translations.vi: "Em không ăn! Em ghét cà chua mà!"
translations.en: "I didn't! I hate tomatoes!"
translations.tl: "Hindi ko kinain! Ayaw ko ng kamatis, eh!"
translations.ne: "मैले खाइनँ! मलाई गोलभेडा मन पर्दैन नि!"
translations.pt: "Não comi! Eu odeio tomate!"
translations.th: "ไม่ได้กิน! ผมเกลียดมะเขือเทศนี่นา!"
translations.si: "මම කෑවේ නැහැ! මට තක්කාලි අප්පිරියයි නේ!"

grammarNote.vi: 食べてない = 食べていない (văn nói).
grammarNote.en: 食べてない = 食べていない (casual).
grammarNote.my: 食べてない = မစားဘူး။
grammarNote.th: 食べてない = ไม่ได้กิน
grammarNote.si: 食べてない = 食べていない (කතා බහේ).

sentences.ja: 二人がけんかをしていると、ベランダに鳥が来ました。

furigana.surface: がけんかをしていると、ベランダに

sentences.romaji: Futari ga kenka o shiteiru to, beranda ni tori ga kimashita.

translations.vi: Đang lúc hai chị em cãi nhau, một con chim bay tới ban công.
translations.en: While they were arguing, a bird landed on the balcony.
translations.zh-Hans: 两个人正在吵架时，一只鸟飞到了阳台上。
translations.zh-Hant: 兩個人正在吵架時，一隻鳥飛到了陽臺上。
translations.ko: 둘이 싸우고 있는데 베란다에 새가 왔습니다.
translations.tl: Habang nag-aaway sila, may ibong dumating sa balkonahe.
translations.ne: दुवै झगडा गरिरहेका बेला बार्दलीमा चरा आयो।
translations.id: Saat mereka bertengkar, seekor burung datang ke balkon.
translations.pt: Enquanto brigavam, um passarinho pousou na varanda.
translations.my: နှစ်ယောက် ရန်ဖြစ်နေတုန်း ဝရန်တာကို ငှက်တစ်ကောင် ရောက်လာတယ်။
translations.th: ขณะที่ทั้งสองทะเลาะกัน ก็มีนกบินมาที่ระเบียง
translations.si: දෙන්නා රණ්ඩු වෙද්දී, බැල්කනියට කුරුල්ලෙක් ආවා.

grammarNote.vi: けんか = cãi nhau. 〜ていると = đang ~ thì.
grammarNote.en: けんか = quarrel. 〜ていると = while ~ing.
grammarNote.zh-Hans: けんか＝吵架。〜ていると＝正……的时候。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: けんか＝吵架。〜ていると＝正……的時候。
grammarNote.my: けんか = ရန်ဖြစ်။
grammarNote.th: けんか = ทะเลาะ
grammarNote.si: けんか = රණ්ඩුව. 〜ていると = ~ කරද්දී.

sentences.ja: 鳥は、赤い実をくわえて、とんでいきました。

furigana.surface: をくわえて、とんでいきました。

sentences.romaji: Tori wa, akai mi o kuwaete, tondeikimashita.

translations.vi: Con chim ngậm một quả đỏ rồi bay đi.
translations.en: The bird grabbed a red fruit in its beak and flew off.
translations.zh-Hans: 鸟叼起一个红果子飞走了。
translations.zh-Hant: 鳥叼起一個紅果子飛走了。
translations.tl: Tinuka ng ibon ang pulang bunga at lumipad.
translations.id: Burung itu menggigit buah merah lalu terbang.
translations.pt: O passarinho pegou um fruto vermelho e voou.
translations.my: ငှက်က အသီးနီကို ကိုက်ပြီး ပျံသွားတယ်။
translations.th: นกคาบผลสีแดงแล้วบินไป
translations.si: කුරුල්ලා රතු ගෙඩියක් හොටෙන් අරගෙන පියාඹලා ගියා.

grammarNote.vi: くわえる = ngậm (trong miệng, mỏ).
grammarNote.en: くわえる = hold in the mouth/beak.
grammarNote.pt: くわえる = segurar no bico.
grammarNote.my: くわえる = ကိုက်ထားတယ်။
grammarNote.th: くわえる = คาบ

sentences.ja: 「あっ！ どろぼう！」
sentences.romaji: “A! Dorobou!”

translations.vi: "A! Đồ ăn trộm!"
translations.en: "Hey! Thief!"
translations.tl: "Hoy! Magnanakaw!"
translations.pt: "Ei! Ladrão!"
translations.th: "อ๊ะ! ขโมย!"

grammarNote.vi: どろぼう = kẻ trộm.
grammarNote.my: どろぼう = သူခိုး။
grammarNote.th: どろぼう = ขโมย

sentences.ja: お父さんが、トマトに白いネットをかけてくれました。

furigana.surface: いネットをかけてくれました。

sentences.romaji: Otousan ga, tomato ni shiroi netto o kaketekuremashita.

translations.vi: Bố phủ một tấm lưới trắng lên cây cà chua.
translations.en: Dad put a white net over the tomatoes.
translations.zh-Hans: 爸爸给番茄罩上了白色的网。
translations.zh-Hant: 爸爸給番茄罩上了白色的網。
translations.ko: 아빠가 토마토에 하얀 그물을 씌워 주었습니다.
translations.tl: Nilagyan ni Tatay ng puting lambat ang kamatis.
translations.id: Ayah memasang jaring putih di tomat.
translations.pt: O pai cobriu os tomates com uma rede branca.
translations.my: အဖေက ခရမ်းချဉ်ပင်ကို ပိုက်ကွန်အဖြူ အုပ်ပေးတယ်။
translations.th: พ่อเอาตาข่ายสีขาวคลุมต้นมะเขือเทศให้
translations.si: තාත්තා තක්කාලි පැළවලට සුදු දැලක් දාලා දුන්නා.

grammarNote.vi: 〜てくれる = (ai đó) làm ~ cho mình.
grammarNote.tl: 〜てくれる = ginawa para sa amin.
grammarNote.my: 〜てくれる = ~ ပေးတယ်။
grammarNote.th: 〜てくれる = ~ ให้

sentences.ja: 「これで、鳥はもう食べられないよ。」
sentences.romaji: “Kore de, tori wa mou taberarenai yo.”

translations.vi: "Thế này thì chim không ăn được nữa đâu."
translations.en: "Now the birds can't eat them anymore."
translations.tl: "Ngayon, hindi na ito makakain ng ibon."
translations.pt: "Assim os pássaros não comem mais."
translations.th: "แบบนี้นกก็กินไม่ได้แล้ว"

grammarNote.vi: 食べられない = không thể ăn.
grammarNote.en: 食べられない = cannot eat.
grammarNote.ko: 食べられない = 못 먹다.
grammarNote.tl: 食べられない = hindi makakain.
grammarNote.ne: 食べられない = खान सक्दैन।
grammarNote.id: 食べられない = tidak bisa makan.
grammarNote.pt: 食べられない = não consegue comer.
grammarNote.my: 食べられない = မစားနိုင်ဘူး။
grammarNote.th: 食べられない = กินไม่ได้
grammarNote.si: 食べられない = කන්න බැහැ.

sentences.ja: 一週間あと、赤い実が、五つもできました。
sentences.romaji: Isshuukan ato, akai mi ga, itsutsu mo dekimashita.

translations.vi: Một tuần sau, có đến năm quả đỏ.
translations.en: A week later, there were five red fruits!
translations.zh-Hans: 一周后，竟然有五个红果子。
translations.zh-Hant: 一週後，竟然有五個紅果子。
translations.ko: 일주일 뒤, 빨간 열매가 다섯 개나 열렸습니다.
translations.tl: Pagkalipas ng isang linggo, may limang pulang bunga na!
translations.ne: एक हप्तापछि पाँचवटा रातो फल लागे।
translations.id: Seminggu kemudian, ada lima buah merah!
translations.pt: Uma semana depois, havia cinco frutos vermelhos!
translations.my: တစ်ပတ်ကြာတော့ အသီးနီ ငါးလုံးတောင် သီးတယ်။
translations.th: หนึ่งสัปดาห์ต่อมา มีผลสีแดงถึงห้าลูก
translations.si: සතියකට පස්සේ, රතු ගෙඩි පහක්ම හැදුණා.

grammarNote.vi: 五つも = đến năm cái (も nhấn mạnh số nhiều).
grammarNote.en: 五つも = as many as five (も stresses a lot).
grammarNote.zh-Hans: 五つも＝竟然五个（も强调多）。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: 五つも＝竟然五個（も強調多）。
grammarNote.my: 五つも = ငါးလုံးတောင်။
grammarNote.th: 五つも = ตั้งห้า
grammarNote.si: 五つも = පහක්ම (も ගොඩක් කියන එක අවධාරණය කරනවා).

sentences.ja: マイちゃんは、一つをビンくんにあげました。

furigana.surface: つをビンくんにあげました。

sentences.romaji: Maichan wa, hitotsu o Binkun ni agemashita.

translations.vi: Mai đưa một quả cho Bin.
translations.en: Mai gave one to Bin.
translations.tl: Binigyan ni Mai si Bin ng isa.
translations.pt: Mai deu um para o Bin.
translations.my: မိုင်က တစ်လုံးကို ဘင့်ကို ပေးတယ်။
translations.th: ไมให้บินไปหนึ่งลูก

grammarNote.vi: あげる = cho (người khác).
grammarNote.my: あげる = ပေးတယ်။
grammarNote.th: あげる = ให้

sentences.ja: 「はい。ビンが毎日、水をあげたトマトだよ。」
sentences.romaji: “Hai. Bin ga mainichi, mizu o ageta tomato da yo.”

translations.vi: "Này. Đây là cà chua mà ngày nào Bin cũng tưới đó."
translations.en: "Here. This is the tomato you watered every day."
translations.zh-Hans: “给。这是你每天浇水的番茄哦。”
translations.zh-Hant: “給。這是你每天澆水的番茄哦。”
translations.tl: "Heto. Ito ang kamatis na dinidiligan mo araw-araw."
translations.ne: "ल। यो तैँले हरेक दिन पानी हालेको गोलभेडा।"
translations.id: "Nih. Ini tomat yang kamu siram tiap hari."
translations.pt: "Toma. É o tomate que você regou todo dia."
translations.th: "นี่ไง มะเขือเทศที่บินรดน้ำทุกวัน"
translations.si: "මෙන්න. මේ බින් හැමදාම වතුර දාපු තක්කාලිය."

grammarNote.vi: 〜た + danh từ = danh từ đã được ~.
grammarNote.th: 〜た + คำนาม

sentences.ja: ビンくんは、目をつぶって、トマトを口に入れました。
sentences.romaji: Binkun wa, me o tsubutte, tomato o kuchi ni iremashita.

translations.vi: Bin nhắm mắt, cho quả cà chua vào miệng.
translations.en: Bin shut his eyes and popped the tomato into his mouth.
translations.zh-Hans: 小宾闭上眼睛，把番茄放进嘴里。
translations.zh-Hant: 小賓閉上眼睛，把番茄放進嘴裡。
translations.ko: 빈은 눈을 꼭 감고 토마토를 입에 넣었습니다.
translations.tl: Pumikit si Bin at isinubo ang kamatis.
translations.ne: बिनले आँखा चिम्लेर गोलभेडा मुखमा हाल्यो।
translations.id: Bin memejamkan mata dan memasukkan tomat ke mulut.
translations.pt: Bin fechou os olhos e pôs o tomate na boca.
translations.my: ဘင်က မျက်လုံးမှိတ်ပြီး ခရမ်းချဉ်သီးကို ပါးစပ်ထဲ ထည့်တယ်။
translations.th: บินหลับตาแล้วเอามะเขือเทศใส่ปาก
translations.si: බින්-කුන් ඇස් පියාගෙන, තක්කාලිය කටට දැම්මා.

grammarNote.vi: 目をつぶる = nhắm mắt.
grammarNote.en: 目をつぶる = close one's eyes.
grammarNote.pt: 目をつぶる = fechar os olhos.
grammarNote.my: 目をつぶる = မျက်လုံးမှိတ်တယ်။
grammarNote.th: 目をつぶる = หลับตา

sentences.ja: しばらく、だまっていました。

furigana.surface: しばらく、だまっていました。

sentences.romaji: Shibaraku, damatteimashita.

translations.vi: Một lúc lâu, cậu bé im lặng.
translations.en: For a while, he said nothing.
translations.tl: Matagal siyang tahimik.
translations.pt: Por um tempo, ficou calado.
translations.my: ခဏလောက် ငြိမ်နေတယ်။
translations.th: เขาเงียบไปพักหนึ่ง

grammarNote.vi: だまる = im lặng.
grammarNote.my: だまる = ငြိမ်နေတယ်။
grammarNote.th: だまる = เงียบ

translations.vi: "...Ngọt!"
translations.en: "...It's sweet!"
translations.tl: "...Matamis!"
translations.pt: "...É doce!"
translations.th: "...หวาน!"

grammarNote.vi: あまい = ngọt.
grammarNote.my: あまい = ချိုတယ်။
grammarNote.th: あまい = หวาน

sentences.ja: 「でしょう？」
sentences.romaji: “Deshou?”

translations.vi: "Thấy chưa?"
translations.en: "See?"
translations.tl: "Di ba?"
translations.pt: "Viu?"
translations.th: "ใช่มั้ยล่ะ"

grammarNote.vi: でしょう？ = đúng không? (tìm đồng ý).
grammarNote.my: でしょう？ = မဟုတ်လား။
grammarNote.th: でしょう？ = ใช่มั้ย

sentences.ja: 「お店のトマトは、きらい。でも、ぼくのトマトは、好き！」

furigana.surface: のトマトは、きらい。でも、ぼくのトマトは、

sentences.romaji: “Omise no tomato wa, kirai. Demo, boku no tomato wa, suki!”

translations.vi: "Cà chua ngoài tiệm thì em ghét. Nhưng cà chua của em thì em thích!"
translations.en: "I hate store tomatoes. But I love MY tomatoes!"
translations.zh-Hans: “店里的番茄我讨厌。但是我的番茄，我喜欢！”
translations.zh-Hant: “店裡的番茄我討厭。但是我的番茄，我喜歡！”
translations.ko: "가게 토마토는 싫어. 근데 내 토마토는 좋아!"
translations.tl: "Ayaw ko ng kamatis sa tindahan. Pero gusto ko ang kamatis ko!"
translations.ne: "पसलको गोलभेडा मन पर्दैन। तर मेरो गोलभेडा मन पर्छ!"
translations.id: "Tomat toko aku nggak suka. Tapi tomatku aku suka!"
translations.pt: "Tomate de loja eu odeio. Mas o meu eu adoro!"
translations.my: "ဆိုင်က ခရမ်းချဉ်သီး မကြိုက်ဘူး။ ဒါပေမဲ့ ကျွန်တော့် ခရမ်းချဉ်သီးကို ကြိုက်တယ်!"
translations.th: "มะเขือเทศที่ร้านผมไม่ชอบ แต่มะเขือเทศของผม ผมชอบ!"
translations.si: "කඩේ තක්කාලි අප්පිරියයි. ඒත් මගේ තක්කාලි නම් කැමතියි!"

grammarNote.vi: AはきらいBは好き = A thì ghét, B thì thích (は so sánh).
grammarNote.en: AはきらいBは好き = dislike A but like B (contrastive は).
grammarNote.zh-Hans: A是讨厌，B是喜欢（は表对比）。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: A是討厭，B是喜歡（は表對比）。
grammarNote.tl: ayaw ang A, gusto ang B.
grammarNote.ne: A मन पर्दैन, B मन पर्छ।
grammarNote.id: A tak suka, B suka (は kontras).
grammarNote.pt: A não, B sim (は de contraste).
grammarNote.th: A ไม่ชอบ B ชอบ (は เปรียบเทียบ)
grammarNote.si: AはきらいBは好き = A ට අකමැතියි, B ට කැමතියි (සැසඳීමේ は).

sentences.ja: その日から、ビンくんは毎朝トマトに言います。
sentences.romaji: Sono hi kara, Binkun wa maiasa tomato ni iimasu.

translations.vi: Từ hôm đó, sáng nào Bin cũng nói với cây cà chua:
translations.en: From that day on, every morning Bin says to the tomatoes:
translations.zh-Hans: 从那天起，小宾每天早上都对番茄说：
translations.zh-Hant: 從那天起，小賓每天早上都對番茄說：
translations.ko: 그날부터 빈은 매일 아침 토마토에게 말합니다.
translations.tl: Mula noon, tuwing umaga sinasabi ni Bin sa kamatis:
translations.ne: त्यस दिनदेखि बिन हरेक बिहान गोलभेडालाई भन्छ:
translations.id: Sejak hari itu, tiap pagi Bin bilang ke tomatnya:
translations.pt: Desde aquele dia, toda manhã Bin diz aos tomates:
translations.my: အဲဒီနေ့ကစပြီး ဘင်က မနက်တိုင်း ခရမ်းချဉ်ပင်ကို ပြောတယ်:
translations.th: ตั้งแต่วันนั้น บินพูดกับต้นมะเขือเทศทุกเช้าว่า
translations.si: ඒ දවසේ ඉඳන්, බින්-කුන් හැමදාම උදේ තක්කාලිවලට කියනවා.

grammarNote.vi: その日から = từ ngày đó.
grammarNote.en: その日から = from that day on.
grammarNote.id: その日から = sejak hari itu.
grammarNote.pt: その日から = desde aquele dia.
grammarNote.my: その日から = အဲဒီနေ့ကစပြီး။
grammarNote.th: その日から = ตั้งแต่วันนั้น
grammarNote.si: その日から = ඒ දවසේ ඉඳන්.

sentences.ja: 「おはよう、トマトくん。今日も一つ、ちょうだい。」
sentences.romaji: “Ohayou, tomatokun. Kyou mo hitotsu, choudai.”

translations.vi: "Chào buổi sáng, bạn Cà Chua. Hôm nay cũng cho em một quả nhé."
translations.en: "Morning, Mr. Tomato. Give me one today too, please."
translations.zh-Hans: “早上好，番茄君。今天也给我一个吧。”
translations.zh-Hant: “早上好，番茄君。今天也給我一個吧。”
translations.tl: "Magandang umaga, G. Kamatis. Isa ulit ngayon, ha."
translations.ne: "शुभ प्रभात, गोलभेडा भाइ। आज पनि एउटा देऊ है।"
translations.id: "Pagi, Tomat. Hari ini kasih satu lagi, ya."
translations.pt: "Bom dia, seu Tomate. Me dá um hoje também."
translations.my: "မင်္ဂလာနံနက်ပါ ခရမ်းချဉ်လေး။ ဒီနေ့လည်း တစ်လုံး ပေးပါ။"
translations.th: "อรุณสวัสดิ์ คุณมะเขือเทศ วันนี้ขออีกลูกนะ"

grammarNote.vi: ちょうだい = cho em (xin thân mật, trẻ con hay dùng).
grammarNote.en: ちょうだい = please give me (casual, childlike).
grammarNote.zh-Hans: ちょうだい＝给我吧（口语）。
grammarNote.zh-Hant: ちょうだい＝給我吧（口語）。
grammarNote.my: ちょうだい = ပေးပါ။
grammarNote.th: ちょうだい = ขอหน่อย
grammarNote.si: ちょうだい = දෙන්නකෝ (කතා බහේ, ළමා කතාව).
